test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 7 to 12. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing ‘8’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4204fe309f52c71d6b3c43015494ed1822e6a1867b70043746e3e34612a97077.png]
solution:
Here, we can see that number 9 and 10 are common in both the dices.

So, we will rotate the dice in such a way that, the positions of both the numbers are the same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0a3307039d05f584f7437872542fc171b7cab44e703a2c51aac5f75874c453.png] 

From this, we can say that the number 12 is opposite to number 8.

Hence, the number '__**12'**__ will be on the face opposite the one showing ‘8’.
